podcast.body: Rick James's 1981 funk classic, which reached number 16 on the charts. This song was later famously transformed into MC Hammer's "U Can't Touch This" and subsequently Nicki Minaj's "Super Freaky Girl." "Rick James' funk classic Super Freak had only reached number 16 in 1981"

podcast.body: This song has been interpolated into Nicki Minaj's "Super Freaky Girl" (a US number one hit) and MC Hammer's "U Can't Touch This." The Hypnosis Song Fund, as custodians of Rick James' catalog, aims to ensure his legacy is celebrated and his music continues to generate income through new uses in movies, TV, video games, samples, and interpolations. "Nicki Minaj's Super Freaky Girl, which is an interpolation of Rick James Super Freak, which obviously was also interpolated into MC Hammer's. You can't touch this."
